mathematical_findings.positive_source: POOL: sum_l q_{alpha,jl}+e_{alpha,j}=p_j(W^alpha), e>=0; one shared AMOUNT yields all-recipient TOTAL<=sum_{j<m}p_j(B), and POSITION-SOURCE is a total-pool coefficient, not a per-column cap.
mathematical_findings.terminal_cap2: Only i_alpha=m: c_alpha<=c_B+1<=2c_B gives sender coefficient sum<=2, and moved terminal clients satisfy c_alpha=c_B-1, yielding column<=2p_m(B) with zero-profit endpoints handled directly.
mathematical_findings.deep_gap: For i_alpha<m, r=m-i_alpha+1 later actions can change load, so only c_alpha<=c_B+r is available and c_alpha=c_B-1 for a recipient is lost; no charge allocates one shared AMOUNT across each target column. DEEP-CAP2 remains open.
mathematical_findings.sharp_lower: Terminal and the context fixed-r nonterminal SPE family both attain ratio 2−3/(n+1), tending to 2; W=OPT, so this is a coefficient lower bound rather than a half counterexample.
mathematical_findings.no_double_spend: retained e, direct/suffix claims and NET's added-cover compensation all draw on the same sender child profit/AMOUNT; no second wallet may be introduced, and AMOUNT initialization from OPT/coverage debt is separately unproved.
